title: Amir Temurning Anqara hiylasi
caption:
Amir Temur Anqara jangida bitta hiyla ishlatgan — javobi videoning oxirida ⚔️

Siz Temur o'rnida qanday hiyla ishlatardingiz? Izohda yozing! 👇

#99foiz #tarix #amirtemur #temuriylar #anqara #ozbekcha #uzbekistan #reels
hero: Amir Temur (66, oq soqol, zirh, salobatli, oqsoqlanadi) + Sulton Boyazid Yildirim (42, qora soqol, oltin dubulg'a, takabbur) + tatar otliqlari
facts: Anqara jangi 28.07.1402, Chubuq tekisligi; Temur ~140 ming, Boyazid ~85 ming + 32 jangovar fil (Wikipedia: Battle of Ankara)
Temur Chubuq soyini (ikki qo'shinning asosiy suv manbai) suv omboriga burib yuborgan; avval Usmonlilar ortiga o'tib, bo'shagan qarorgohini egallagan (Wikipedia)

Qora tatarlar va Anadolu beyliklarining sipohiylari Temur tomonga o'tgan; Boyazid asir olingan — Usmonli sultoni shaxsan asir olingan yagona holat; 3 oydan keyin asirlikda vafot etgan (Wikipedia, Britannica)

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [excited] Amir Temur sultonni qanday hiyla bilan yengdi?
scenes.text: Amir Temur sultonni qanday hiyla bilan yengdi?
scenes.frames: Amir Temur on horseback in the foreground, behind him a vast Ottoman army with war elephants, dust and banners, dramatic miniature painting style, motion

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [mysterious] Javob oxirida. Avval — kim bilan kim to'qnashdi?
scenes.text: Javob oxirida. Avval — kim bilan kim to'qnashdi?
scenes.frames: close-up of Amir Temur's hand on a sword hilt over a parchment map

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [serious] Olti asr oldin. Anqara yonidagi Chubuq tekisligi.
scenes.text: Olti asr oldin. Anqara yonidagi Chubuq tekisligi.
scenes.frames: parchment map of Anatolia with Ankara and the Chubuk plain marked, two army camps drawn

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [proud] Bir tomonda — Amir Temur. Yuz qirq mingga yaqin qo'shin.
scenes.text: Bir tomonda — Amir Temur. Yuz qirq mingga yaqin qo'shin.
scenes.frames: Amir Temur, 66, white beard, armor, majestic, on horseback before his troops

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [surprised] Qarshisida — sulton Boyazid. Sakson besh ming askar... va fillar!
scenes.text: Qarshisida — sulton Boyazid. Sakson besh ming askar... va fillar!
scenes.frames: sudden reveal: Ottoman army with 32 war elephants and janissaries lined up on a dusty plain

scenes.speaker: sardor
scenes.tts: [proud] Men Yildirimman! Bu jang meniki bo'ladi!
scenes.text: Men Yildirimman! Bu jang meniki bo'ladi!
scenes.frames: Sultan Bayezid, 42, black beard, golden helmet, confident dignified pose in his tent

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [whispers] Lekin jangdan oldin Temur bir narsani payqadi... Endi diqqat.
scenes.text: Lekin jangdan oldin Temur bir narsani payqadi... Endi diqqat.
scenes.frames: Amir Temur studying a map in his tent by lamplight, his finger stopping on a thin blue line

scenes.speaker: jahongir
scenes.tts: [elderly voice] [calm] Shoshilmang. Avval ularning orqasiga o'tamiz.
scenes.text: Shoshilmang. Avval ularning orqasiga o'tamiz.
scenes.frames: Amir Temur calmly raising his hand, speaking to his commanders

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [mysterious] Temur qo'shini Usmonlilar ortiga o'tib, bo'shagan qarorgohini egalladi.
scenes.text: Temur qo'shini Usmonlilar ortiga o'tib, bo'shagan qarorgohini egalladi.
scenes.frames: parchment map with curved arrows showing Timur's army circling behind the Ottomans to their empty camp

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [tense] Nega aynan o'sha joy? Bu hiylaning birinchi bo'lagi edi.
scenes.text: Nega aynan o'sha joy? Bu hiylaning birinchi bo'lagi edi.
scenes.frames: Timur's horsemen entering the abandoned Ottoman camp, empty tents, question-mark mood

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [tense] Jang boshlandi. Va shu yerda tarix burilib ketdi...
scenes.text: Jang boshlandi. Va shu yerda tarix burilib ketdi...
scenes.frames: massive cavalry clash in dust, arrows in the sky, miniature painting style

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [surprised] Boyazid safidagi qora tatarlar... birdan Temur tomonga o'tdi!
scenes.text: Boyazid safidagi qora tatarlar... birdan Temur tomonga o'tdi!
scenes.frames: Tatar horsemen turning around mid-battle and riding toward Timur's banners

scenes.speaker: sardor
scenes.tts: [shocked] Nima?! O'z otliqlarim menga qarshi?!
scenes.text: Nima?! O'z otliqlarim menga qarshi?!
scenes.frames: Sultan Bayezid shocked on his horse, looking back at his departing cavalry

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [serious] Anadolu beyliklarining sipohiylari ham ularga qo'shildi.
scenes.text: Anadolu beyliklarining sipohiylari ham ularga qo'shildi.
scenes.frames: more Anatolian cavalry banners crossing the battlefield to Timur's side

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [mysterious] Bir ishora: Temur egallagan joy yonidan Chubuq soyi oqardi.
scenes.text: Bir ishora: Temur egallagan joy yonidan Chubuq soyi oqardi.
scenes.frames: parchment map close-up: a small stream (Chubuk) flowing past the captured camp, circled

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [whispers] Va mana eng qizig'i... Temurning asl hiylasi nima edi?
scenes.text: Va mana eng qizig'i... Temurning asl hiylasi nima edi?
scenes.frames: slow push-in on Amir Temur's calm face at the edge of the battlefield

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [excited] Temur ikki qo'shinning asosiy suv manbai — Chubuq soyini — suv omboriga burib yuborgan edi!
scenes.text: Temur ikki qo'shinning asosiy suv manbai — Chubuq soyini — suv omboriga burib yuborgan edi!
scenes.frames: Timur's soldiers digging a channel to divert the Chubuk stream into a reservoir, water flowing away from the Ottoman side

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [serious] Suvsiz qolgan Usmonli qo'shini yengildi. Sulton Boyazid asir olindi.
scenes.text: Suvsiz qolgan Usmonli qo'shini yengildi. Sulton Boyazid asir olindi.
scenes.frames: Ottoman ranks breaking under the burning sun; Sultan Bayezid captured by Timur's horsemen, dignified

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [serious] Bu — Usmonli sultoni shaxsan asir olingan yagona holat.
scenes.text: Bu — Usmonli sultoni shaxsan asir olingan yagona holat.
scenes.frames: Amir Temur seated in a grand tent, captive Sultan Bayezid brought before him, respectful solemn mood

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [warmly] Siz Temur o'rnida qanday hiyla ishlatardingiz? Izohda yozing!
scenes.text: Siz Temur o'rnida qanday hiyla ishlatardingiz? Izohda yozing!
scenes.frames: Amir Temur at sunset on a hill looking over the plain, banners waving
